metadata.name: sooth_market
metadata.description: Sooth Protocol market lifecycle + custody program (TruthMarket + OrderEngine port)

instructions.name: add_adjudicator
docs: Append a pubkey to the adjudicator allowlist (gated on
`allowlist.authority`). See `instructions/add_adjudicator.rs`.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Refund an AMM Position on a dismissed market, then close the Position
via `sooth_amm::close_dismissed_position`.

accounts.name: amm_state
docs: AMM state is owned by `sooth_amm`; this program validates owner, PDA,
backlink, and the raw `is_dismissed` byte before moving funds.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority signer-only PDA owned by this program.

accounts.name: position
docs: AMM Position account. The account is owner/seed/raw-field checked in
this handler, then closed by the AMM CPI.

accounts.name: sooth_amm_program
docs: AMM program, invoked manually to avoid a Cargo cycle.

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar forwarded to the AMM close helper.

instructions.name: initialize_adjudicator_allowlist
docs: One-shot bootstrap of the singleton adjudicator allowlist PDA.
Codex C2 minimum-viable mitigation — see
`state/adjudicator_allowlist.rs`. MUST be called before any
`initialize_market` ix; market creation now requires the allowlist
PDA to exist.

accounts.name: allowlist
docs: New singleton allowlist PDA. `init` (not `init_if_needed`) — re-init
must be impossible.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Pays the rent-exempt deposit for the allowlist account. Note: this is
distinct from the `authority` arg — typically a deployer wallet pays
rent while the multisig governance key is recorded as the authority.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Create the Market PDA, both outcome SPL mints, and the USDC vault ATA.
Architecture §4.1; mirrors EVM `LaunchpadEngine.createMarket` (which
deployed a TruthMarket clone) — on Solana we collapse the deploy step
into native PDA initialization.

accounts.name: market
docs: New Market PDA. `init` (not `init_if_needed`) — re-init must be
impossible on this account.

accounts.name: adjudicator_allowlist
docs: Singleton allowlist of permitted adjudicator pubkeys. Read-only here;
the handler verifies `args.adjudicator` is present. Codex C2 minimum-
viable mitigation — see `state/adjudicator_allowlist.rs`.
Account-resolution will fail if the allowlist PDA has not been
initialised yet (closed-by-default posture).

instructions.name: initialize_market_vaults
docs: Third leg of the create-market flow — initializes the USDC vault +
lock-vault ATAs, then flips the market lifecycle from `Initializing`
→ `Open`. Split per the rationale in `initialize_market.rs`.

accounts.name: market
docs: Existing Market PDA — must be in `Initializing`. Bumps were pinned at
`initialize_market`; we re-derive seeds here to validate the address.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Signer-only PDA. Owner of the USDC vault ATA. CHECK: derived via
seeds; safe.

accounts.name: lock_authority
docs: Signer-only PDA. Owner of the lock-vault ATA. CHECK: derived via
seeds; safe.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint reference. H1 (Codex): pinned on-chain to the canonical
cluster USDC via the `address = ...` constraint so a malicious caller
cannot bootstrap a market with their own mint — `mint_complete_set`,
`merge_complete_set`, and (when implemented) `redeem` all trust
`vault.mint` as USDC by transitivity through this pin. EVM analogue:
`OrderEngine.sol:68` declares `baseToken` as `immutable` and rejects
the zero address at construction (`OrderEngine.sol:180`); on Solana
we enforce the equivalent at vault-init time.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market USDC vault — created as the ATA of `vault_authority`.

accounts.name: lock_vault
docs: AMM lock-on-sell escrow vault. See `lock_vault` placement note in
`state/market.rs` and architecture §4.3.

instructions.name: initialize_outcome_mints
docs: Second leg of the create-market flow — initializes both outcome SPL
mints. Split from `initialize_market` and `initialize_market_vaults`
so each ix's `try_accounts` codegen stays under the SBF 4 KB stack
frame; see `instructions/initialize_market.rs` module comment.

accounts.name: market
docs: Existing Market PDA — must be in `Initializing` and the outcome mints
must still be unpopulated (yes_mint == default()).

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Signer-only PDA. Mint authority for both outcome mints. CHECK:
derived via seeds; safe.

instructions.name: lock_for_resolution
docs: Lock the market for resolution (LIVE → LOCKED). EVM analogue:
`TruthMarket.resolve` (`TruthMarket.sol:90-106`).

accounts.name: adjudicator_pda
docs: `sooth_adjudicator::Adjudicator` PDA — read-only here. Forwarded by
the CPI from `sooth_adjudicator::request_lock`. Pinned to the
matching adjudicator-program seed via the `owner` constraint so a
caller cannot substitute a forged Adjudicator account from another
program. CHECK: ownership-pinned; the contents are not parsed here
(the introspection check is the load-bearing auth gate; this account
is along for the ride to keep the CPI account-list shape parallel
to `settle` and to give indexers a stable reference).

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar — read by the parent-ix introspection check.
Pinned to the canonical sysvar pubkey via the `address` constraint
so a malicious caller cannot substitute a forged sysvar account.

instructions.name: merge_complete_set
docs: Merge a complete set — burn `amount` YES + `amount` NO, return
`amount` USDC to the user. EVM analogue: `OrderEngine._merge`
(`OrderEngine.sol:696-712`).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market USDC vault. H1 (Codex): the canonical-USDC pin lives on
`initialize_market_vaults::usdc_mint` and is transitively enforced
here via `vault.mint == USDC_MINT_DEVNET`. See the matching comment
in `mint_complete_set.rs`.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC ATA — credited.

accounts.name: user_yes_ata
docs: User's YES outcome-token ATA — burned from.

accounts.name: user_no_ata
docs: User's NO outcome-token ATA — burned from.

instructions.name: mint_complete_set
docs: Mint a "complete set" — pull `amount` USDC from user, mint `amount`
YES + `amount` NO into the user's outcome ATAs. EVM analogue:
`OrderEngine._mint` (`OrderEngine.sol:680-694`).

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority PDA — signs the mint_to CPIs.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market USDC vault. Constraint pin: must match the address stored on
`Market` at init time. H1 (Codex): the canonical-USDC pin lives on
`initialize_market_vaults::usdc_mint` (`address = USDC_MINT_DEVNET`),
and the vault was created at that ix as ATA-of-`vault_authority` with
`associated_token::mint = usdc_mint`, so `vault.mint` is transitively
bound to `USDC_MINT_DEVNET` here — the `token::mint = vault.mint`
constraint on the user ATA below therefore pins the user side too.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC ATA — debited.

accounts.name: user_yes_ata
docs: User's YES outcome-token ATA — credited.

accounts.name: user_no_ata
docs: User's NO outcome-token ATA — credited.

instructions.name: mint_complete_set_to_program_owned
docs: Split-authority complete-set mint for CPI escrow flows — pull
`amount` USDC from a payer and mint YES + NO into token accounts owned
by a separate destination authority.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority PDA — signs the mint_to CPIs.

accounts.name: market_vault
docs: Market USDC vault — credited from the payer.

accounts.name: payer_usdc_ata
docs: Payer's USDC ATA — debited.

accounts.name: destination_authority
docs: Destination authority for the YES/NO token accounts.

accounts.name: destination_yes_ata
docs: Destination YES outcome-token ATA — credited.

accounts.name: destination_no_ata
docs: Destination NO outcome-token ATA — credited.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Redeem winning shares for USDC. EVM analogue:
`OrderEngine.settlePosition` (`OrderEngine.sol:399-431`).
Body branches on `market.winning_outcome` per the EVM
`TruthMarket.getRedemptionValue` table (1.0 USDC for the winning side,
0.5 for both on INVALID).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market USDC vault. The canonical-USDC pin is transitive via
`initialize_market_vaults` (same chain documented on
`mint_complete_set`/`merge_complete_set`); the explicit
`vault.mint == USDC_MINT_DEVNET` constraint here is cheap defense-
in-depth and keeps the IDL self-documenting.

instructions.name: redeem_from_program_owned
docs: Split-destination redemption for CPI escrow flows — burn requested
YES/NO amounts from a burn authority and pay USDC to an arbitrary
token account.

instructions.name: remove_adjudicator
docs: Remove a pubkey from the adjudicator allowlist (gated on
`allowlist.authority`). See `instructions/remove_adjudicator.rs`.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Settle the market with the adjudicator's winning outcome
(LOCKED → SETTLED). EVM analogue: `TruthMarket.attest` +
`TruthMarket.settle` collapsed (`TruthMarket.sol:112-131`).

accounts.name: adjudicator_pda
docs: `sooth_adjudicator::Adjudicator` PDA — read-only here. Forwarded by
the CPI from `sooth_adjudicator::attest_outcome`. Pinned via owner
constraint (same rationale as `lock_for_resolution`). CHECK:
ownership-pinned; introspection is the load-bearing auth gate.

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar for parent-ix introspection. Address-pinned.

instructions.name: transfer_from_lock_vault
docs: PDA-signed transfer `lock_vault → recipient`. Helper for
`sooth_amm::claim_unlocked` — same rationale as `transfer_to_lock`.
See `instructions/transfer_from_lock_vault.rs` for the auth model.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — read-only. Used to seed the lock_authority signer.

accounts.name: lock_authority
docs: Lock-authority signer-only PDA owned by `sooth_market`. CHECK: derived.

accounts.name: lock_vault
docs: AMM lock-on-sell escrow vault — debited.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Recipient USDC ATA (the user's token account).

accounts.name: lock_entry
docs: LockEntry account from `sooth_amm`. Owner + field validation runs in
the handler (see module docstring). CHECK: hand-validated.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint reference. Pinned to canonical USDC.

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar — read by the parent-ix introspection check
(see module docstring §"Auth model" and
`instruction_introspection::require_parent_ix`). Pinned to the
canonical sysvar pubkey via the `address` constraint so a malicious
caller cannot substitute a forged sysvar account with a fabricated
instruction list. CHECK: address-pinned.

instructions.name: transfer_to_lock
docs: PDA-signed transfer `vault → lock_vault`. Helper for
`sooth_amm::sell_positions` — the AMM CPIs into this so the signing
PDA (`vault_authority`) is owned by the correct program. See
`instructions/transfer_to_lock.rs` for the auth model.

accounts.name: market
docs: Market PDA — read-only. Used to seed the vault_authority signer and
to validate position.market binding.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority signer-only PDA owned by `sooth_market`. We sign with
it here on behalf of the AMM. CHECK: derived via seeds.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Market USDC vault — debited.

accounts.name: lock_vault
docs: AMM lock-on-sell escrow vault — credited.

accounts.name: position
docs: Per-(user, market) Position from `sooth_amm`. We can't type this as
`Account<'info, sooth_amm::Position>` without a circular path-dep
(sooth_amm already depends on sooth_market via the `cpi` feature).
The handler verifies owner + parses `user`/`market` from raw bytes.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint reference. Pinned to canonical USDC.

accounts.name: user
docs: User signature is the auth gate (the outer `sell_positions` ix
requires a user signature; that flows down through the CPI).

accounts.name: instruction_sysvar
docs: Instructions sysvar — read by the parent-ix introspection check
(see module docstring §"Auth model" and
`instruction_introspection::require_parent_ix`). Pinned to the
canonical sysvar pubkey via the `address` constraint so a malicious
caller cannot substitute a forged sysvar account with a fabricated
instruction list. CHECK: address-pinned.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority permitted to call `add_adjudicator` / `remove_adjudicator`.
Set once at `initialize_adjudicator_allowlist` time. Intended to be
the protocol multisig.

fields.name: entries
docs: Fixed-size pubkey table. Slots beyond `entry_count` are guaranteed
zero (we never leave stale data behind on remove — see
`remove_adjudicator`).

fields.name: entry_count
docs: Number of populated slots in `entries` (0..=ADJUDICATOR_ALLOWLIST_CAPACITY).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for the singleton PDA.

types.name: CompleteSetMerged
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.Merged` (`OrderEngine.sol:125`).

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC base units returned to user.

types.name: CompleteSetMinted
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.Minted` (`OrderEngine.sol:124`).

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: USDC base units pulled from user.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Deterministic 16-byte id (truncated keccak256 of question || creator
|| nonce). Architecture §2.2.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: Adjudicator program id. The CPI auth check on lifecycle setters will
validate against this — left as `todo!()` for now.

fields.name: market_id
docs: Deterministic id derived from `keccak256(question || creator || nonce)`,
truncated to 16 bytes per architecture §2.2. Seed for every per-market
PDA in the protocol — see module comment.

fields.name: adjudicator
docs: Adjudicator program id. The adjudicator-CPI auth check on `lock` /
`settle` will validate the caller's program against this.

fields.name: vault
docs: USDC ATA owned by `vault_authority` PDA. All collateral for this market.

fields.name: lock_vault
docs: USDC ATA owned by `lock_authority` PDA. AMM lock-on-sell escrow.

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: Resolved outcome, valid only when `lifecycle == Settled`.
0 = NO, 1 = YES, 2 = INVALID per protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for the `Market` PDA itself.

fields.name: vault_authority_bump
docs: Bump for the `vault_authority` signer PDA.

fields.name: lock_authority_bump
docs: Bump for the `lock_authority` signer PDA.

fields.name: yes_mint_bump
docs: Bump for `yes_mint` PDA.

fields.name: no_mint_bump
docs: Bump for `no_mint` PDA.

types.name: MarketLocked
docs: Mirror of EVM `TruthMarket.MarketResolved` (LIVE → RESOLVING). Renamed to
"Locked" to match Solana lifecycle names — the semantic intent is the same:
trading halts pending adjudicator outcome. See `state/lifecycle.rs`.

types.name: MarketSettled
docs: Mirror of EVM `TruthMarket.MarketSettled` (`TruthMarket.sol:130`).

fields.name: winning_outcome
docs: 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID per protocol-wide OUTCOME encoding.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: Mirror of EVM `OrderEngine.PositionSettled` (`OrderEngine.sol:430`).
Emitted by `redeem` after a successful post-settlement burn-and-pay.

fields.name: outcome
docs: Resolved outcome at the time of redeem, copied from
`Market::winning_outcome`. 0=NO, 1=YES, 2=INVALID.

fields.name: yes_burned
docs: YES outcome-token base units burned (0 if user held none, or if
outcome=NO).

fields.name: no_burned
docs: NO outcome-token base units burned (0 if user held none, or if
outcome=YES).

fields.name: usdc_paid
docs: USDC base units transferred from vault to user.
